reviewMethod: Manual before/after/diff review of all 90 deterministic captures from exact-head run 36687027520, grouped across fifteen contact sheets, plus structural overflow/touch-target guards.
note: Expected P10 deltas only: tokenized radius/spacing/type, accessible blue CTA contrast, small-muted contrast, mobile shell hardening for extreme text scale, progress rounding, and focus/icon semantics. No clipping, hidden critical action, horizontal overflow increase, touch-target regression, broken choice/offer/action layout, or unexpected content/data change observed.
